title: Salary vs. company average
prompt: Return each employee's name, salary, and the overall average salary (same value repeated on every row) as a column named avg_salary, using a scalar subquery.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE emp5 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, salary INTEGER); INSERT INTO emp5 VALUES (1,'A',50000),(2,'B',70000),(3,'C',90000);
reference_sql: SELECT name, salary, (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM emp5) AS avg_salary FROM emp5;
